tasks.label: Inspect showtime destination schema
args: SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('rooms','seats','showtimes') ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position; SELECT id, name, total_seats FROM rooms ORDER BY id; SELECT id, room_id FROM seats ORDER BY room_id, id LIMIT 12;

tasks.label: Check booking showtime references
args: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='bookings' ORDER BY ordinal_position; SELECT id, showtime_id, status FROM bookings ORDER BY id;

tasks.label: Inspect ID 7 booking and schedule
args: SELECT id, showtime_id, movie_title, show_time, status FROM bookings ORDER BY id;

tasks.label: Inspect exported room 4 data
args: ls -l /tmp/source_room4.csv /tmp/source_room4_seats.csv 2>&1; echo ROOM_FILE; cat /tmp/source_room4.csv 2>/dev/null; echo SEAT_FILE; head -n 12 /tmp/source_room4_seats.csv 2>/dev/null

tasks.label: Verify source room and showtime files
args: for f in /tmp/source_room4.csv /tmp/source_room4_seats.csv /tmp/source_showtimes.csv; do echo ===$f===; ls -l $f; head -n 12 $f; done

tasks.label: Preflight showtime ID merge
args: SELECT id,name,total_seats FROM rooms ORDER BY id; SELECT COUNT(*) AS seats, MAX(id) AS max_seat_id FROM seats; SELECT id,movie_id,room_id,start_time FROM showtimes WHERE id BETWEEN 7 AND 32 ORDER BY id;

tasks.label: Merge source room seats showtimes
args: BEGIN; CREATE TEMP TABLE src_rooms(id bigint, name varchar, total_seats integer); COPY src_rooms FROM '/tmp/source_room4.csv' WITH (FORMAT csv, HEADER true); CREATE TEMP TABLE src_seats(id bigint, room_id bigint, seat_row varchar, seat_number integer, seat_type varchar); COPY src_seats FROM '/tmp/source_room4_seats.csv' WITH (FORMAT csv, HEADER true); CREATE TEMP TABLE src_showtimes(id bigint, movie_id bigint, room_id bigint, start_time timestamp without time zone, end_time timestamp without time zone, price numeric, status varchar); COPY src_showtimes FROM '/tmp/source_showtimes.csv' WITH (FORMAT csv, HEADER true); INSERT INTO rooms(id,name,total_seats) SELECT id,name,total_seats FROM src_rooms ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET name=EXCLUDED.name,total_seats=EXCLUDED.total_seats; INSERT INTO seats(id,room_id,seat_row,seat_number,seat_type) SELECT id,room_id,seat_row,seat_number,seat_type FROM src_seats ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET room_id=EXCLUDED.room_id,seat_row=EXCLUDED.seat_row,seat_number=EXCLUDED.seat_number,seat_type=EXCLUDED.seat_type; UPDATE showtimes SET id=id+26 WHERE id BETWEEN 7 AND 32; INSERT INTO showtimes(id,movie_id,room_id,start_time,end_time,price,status) SELECT id,movie_id,room_id,start_time,end_time,price,status FROM src_showtimes ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET movie_id=EXCLUDED.movie_id,room_id=EXCLUDED.room_id,start_time=EXCLUDED.start_time,end_time=EXCLUDED.end_time,price=EXCLUDED.price,status=EXCLUDED.status; SELECT setval('rooms_id_seq',(SELECT MAX(id) FROM rooms),true); SELECT setval('seats_id_seq',(SELECT MAX(id) FROM seats),true); SELECT setval('showtimes_id_seq',(SELECT MAX(id) FROM showtimes),true); SELECT 'rooms' AS table_name,COUNT(*) FROM rooms UNION ALL SELECT 'seats',COUNT(*) FROM seats UNION ALL SELECT 'showtimes',COUNT(*) FROM showtimes; COMMIT;

tasks.label: Preserve shifted booking link
args: UPDATE bookings SET showtime_id = showtime_id + 26 WHERE showtime_id BETWEEN 7 AND 32 RETURNING id, showtime_id, movie_title, show_time, status;

tasks.label: Verify merged showtimes and rooms
args: SELECT id,name,total_seats FROM rooms ORDER BY id; SELECT room_id,COUNT(*) AS seat_rows FROM seats GROUP BY room_id ORDER BY room_id; SELECT id,movie_id,room_id,start_time,end_time,price,status FROM showtimes WHERE id <= 7 ORDER BY id; SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_showtimes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE start_time > LOCALTIMESTAMP AND status='OPEN') AS upcoming_open FROM showtimes; SELECT COUNT(*) AS room_conflicts FROM (SELECT room_id,start_time,LAG(end_time) OVER (PARTITION BY room_id ORDER BY start_time) AS prior_end FROM showtimes WHERE status <> 'CANCELLED') x WHERE prior_end > start_time;

tasks.label: Verify booking showtime link
args: SELECT b.id,b.showtime_id,b.movie_title,b.show_time,s.movie_id,s.room_id,s.start_time FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN cinema_showtime_db.public.showtimes s ON false WHERE b.id=4; SELECT id,showtime_id,movie_title,show_time,status FROM bookings WHERE id=4;

tasks.label: Final showtime integrity checks
args: SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_showtimes FROM showtimes WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 7; SELECT movie_id, COUNT(*) AS upcoming FROM showtimes WHERE status='OPEN' AND start_time > LOCALTIMESTAMP GROUP BY movie_id HAVING COUNT(*) <> 2; SELECT COUNT(*) AS overlaps FROM (SELECT room_id,start_time,LAG(end_time) OVER (PARTITION BY room_id ORDER BY start_time) AS prior_end FROM showtimes WHERE status <> 'CANCELLED') q WHERE prior_end > start_time;

tasks.label: Inspect notification target schema
args: SELECT column_name,data_type,column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='notifications' ORDER BY ordinal_position; SELECT COUNT(*) AS notification_count FROM notifications;

tasks.label: Inspect payment target schema
args: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type,column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('payments','refunds') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position; SELECT 'payments' AS table_name,COUNT(*) FROM payments UNION ALL SELECT 'refunds',COUNT(*) FROM refunds;

tasks.label: Inspect booking target schema
args: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type,column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('bookings','booking_seats','seat_reservations') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position; SELECT 'bookings' AS table_name,COUNT(*) FROM bookings UNION ALL SELECT 'booking_seats',COUNT(*) FROM booking_seats UNION ALL SELECT 'seat_reservations',COUNT(*) FROM seat_reservations;

tasks.label: Check notification conflicts
args: SELECT id,user_id,booking_id,type,status,event_id,content FROM notifications ORDER BY id; SELECT conname,pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.notifications'::regclass; SELECT indexname,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename='notifications';
